summary: Solid UI and templ toasts take one action ("Undo", "Retry") and use the light SDK surface with polite/alert announcements and a phone layout above bottom bars; Dialog and Drawer gain a busy state that refuses every close while a request runs; @iota-uz/sdk/testing adds expectNoA11yViolations (optional peer @axe-core/playwright); docs/automation-ui-standard.md defines the automation UI/UX acceptance standard.
